title: What the vizier whispered about his sultan | Folio 7 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
In one scene from those last days, Beyhaqi shows us the vizier speaking privately to none other than Bu Sahl Zawzani. That vizier was Ahmad, the old steward of Altuntash. And he says a sentence that Beyhaqi wrote down. In Persian, it is very short. In soltan na an ast ke bud. This sultan is not the man he was. I find it hard to hear that line without thinking of the old general who died at Dabusiyya. Ahmad had seen, with his own eyes, what loyalty looked like. He had seen a man stay faithful to a master who did not deserve it. And now, years later, he was watching that same master lose his way.

The full story: Folio 7: The Secret Order Against the Loyal General — on our channel and on every podcast app.
